description: Creation of car parking spaces to rear; Relocation of refuse bins at rear; Installation of new fence and gate at rear; Installation of 7 storage container units at the rear (Demolition of detached outbuilding)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed seven self-storage container units would
introduce a poorly integrated and incompatible B8 use within the designated local
parade, resulting in a segregated planning unit that would fail to support the
vitality and coherent operation of the premises on the parade in addition to
detrimental impacts on &nbsp;the existing residential
&nbsp;occupiers of the site. As such, the
proposal is contrary to Policy LE1(C) of the Harrow Local Plan 2021–2041 (2026).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The development would provide inadequate parking provision and
a highly constrained access arrangement to existing residential occupiers and commercial
users of the proposed commercial units. As such, the proposal is contrary to policy
D13 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies GR3B and M2<b> </b>of the Harrow
Local Plan 2021–2041 (2026).<o:p></o:p></p>
